blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several roads in Pasay City will be closed from Oct. 24 to Nov. 20 for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, according to the Pasay Traffic and Parking Management Office (PTMPO). In an advisory, the PTMPO said road closures and traffic changes are expected around the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) and the Cultural Center of the Philippines. As the Philippines hosts this year’s Asean summit, the main venue will be the PICC, while other events will be held at the Coconut Palace.
